prompt_templates.hero: Home living hero banner for {product_name}. Product styled as hero within a beautiful modern interior, natural daylight through window, {visual_style} aesthetic. Aspirational but real, editorial home magazine quality, generous negative space for headline, 8K, no text overlay.
prompt_templates.pain_point: Problem-solution panel for {product_name}. Soft split composition showing the household problem before and the calm/organized result after. Warm tones, clean design, relatable but elevated, no actual text.
prompt_templates.core_selling: Benefit panel for {product_name}. Product + 2-4 visualized home benefits (space-saving, easy-clean, quiet, durable) arranged as clean graphic blocks or icon zones. {visual_style} aesthetic, modern home brand layout, {language} market. No dense text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Home lifestyle panel for {product_name}. Product naturally placed in a beautiful modern home interior, Scandinavian decor, warm natural light, aspirational living space. Hands-only or no human presence, {language} cultural context.
prompt_templates.detail: Craft detail panel for {product_name}. Macro shot of craftsmanship, material texture, mechanism, or surface finish. Shallow depth of field, professional product photography, clean background. Magazine-grade close-up.
prompt_templates.spec_param: Specification panel for {product_name}. Minimalist infographic layout with {brand_color} accents, thin iconography, and product peeking from one side. Professional data visualization, placeholder layout, no actual text.
prompt_templates.size_chart: Dimension guide panel for {product_name}. Product shown with stylized figure, mannequin, or dimensional diagram; thin elegant measurement lines, minimalist design, generous whitespace. No actual readable text.
prompt_templates.cta: Final conversion panel for {product_name}. Premium home layout: product in lifestyle setting + prominent CTA block + trust badges. {visual_style} tones, no text.
